# Anti-Patterns
- Do not document commands that are not present or not executable here.
- Do not keep placeholder headers without repository-specific content.
- Do not duplicate the same rule across instructions, prompts, and skills
  without a clear owner.
- Do not include absolute local machine paths inside shared guidance.
- Do not overfit guidance to one AI tool when the workspace supports several.
- Do not overwrite existing instruction or prompt files during setup.
- Do not include secrets, tokens, or private URLs in markdown artifacts.
- Do not claim runtime architecture details for this folder; it is
  documentation scaffolding.
- Do not drift prompt output formats between prompt and matching skill files
  unless both are updated together.
